'''Convoy 1''' was one of three [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|Republic Troop Transports]] deployed from an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] on one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] during the [[Battle of Thule]]. It was destroyed, along with its complement of [[clone engineer]]s, en route to the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] [[Sivvi shield generator complex|complex]] by mortar fire from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Heavy Artillery Gun|artillery]].
